scope: RX parser locking and Andes dequeue boundary source evidence, no drain implementation
conclusions: PCI GetPacketFromRxRing invokes parser while holding selected RxRingLock, so taking that lock joins an already executing PCI parser only
Taking ring lock cannot prove hardware has stopped producing old TxS or exhaust future ring entries
Andes bottom half dequeues message then runs parser outside queue critical section; queue emptiness is not callback completion
A valid reusable BSS boundary needs all producer fence, actual flush completion, hardware-to-host report drain and both callback paths accounted, in established lock order
No global tasklet kill/IRQ mask or MCU ACK change is authorized by this source audit
